description: Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) techniques adapted for Antahpura dynamics. Each technique provides mechanical effects on emotional regulation, distress tolerance, interpersonal effectiveness, and mindfulness.

mindfulness.name: Mindfulness
mindfulness.bdsm_application: Staying present during intense scenes; observing sensations without judgment; participating fully in the dynamic.

distress_tolerance.name: Distress Tolerance
distress_tolerance.description: Surviving crises without making things worse.
distress_tolerance.bdsm_application: Handling sub drop, dom drop, and scene-related distress without escalating; using ACCEPTS to distract during aftercare.

emotion_regulation.name: Emotion Regulation
emotion_regulation.bdsm_application: Recognizing emotional states in the dynamic; using opposite action to counter shame; building mastery through kala practice.

interpersonal_effectiveness.name: Interpersonal Effectiveness
interpersonal_effectiveness.description: Asking for what you need, saying no, and maintaining relationships.
interpersonal_effectiveness.bdsm_application: Negotiating scenes, setting boundaries, and maintaining the health of the dynamic.

TIPP.name: TIPP
TIPP.acronym_expansion: Temperature, Intense exercise, Paced breathing, Paired muscle relaxation
TIPP.description: Fast-acting technique to reduce extreme emotional arousal.
steps: Temperature: Cold water on face or hold ice
Intense exercise: 10-15 minutes of high-intensity movement
Paced breathing: Breathe in for 4, out for 6
Paired muscle relaxation: Tense and relax muscle groups
TIPP.bdsm_context: Useful during sub drop or dom drop. Can be applied by partner or self-directed.

STOP.name: STOP
STOP.acronym_expansion: Stop, Take a step back, Observe, Proceed mindfully
STOP.description: Pause before reacting to emotional triggers.
steps: Stop: Freeze. Do not react.
Take a step back: Remove yourself from the situation.
Observe: Notice what is happening inside and outside.
Proceed mindfully: Act with awareness.
STOP.bdsm_context: Useful when a scene triggers an unexpected emotional response. Allows renegotiation.

ACCEPTS.name: ACCEPTS
ACCEPTS.acronym_expansion: Activities, Contributing, Comparisons, Emotions, Pushing away, Thoughts, Sensations
ACCEPTS.description: Distraction techniques for surviving crisis without making it worse.
steps: Activities: Engage in a distracting activity
Contributing: Do something for someone else
Comparisons: Compare to a worse time
Emotions: Generate a different emotion
Pushing away: Temporarily push the problem out of mind
Thoughts: Replace thoughts with counting or puzzles
Sensations: Use intense sensory input (cold, sour, loud)
ACCEPTS.bdsm_context: Useful during aftercare when the drop is hitting hard. Sensation technique can be integrated with toy/substance use.

IMPROVE.name: IMPROVE the Moment
IMPROVE.acronym_expansion: Imagery, Meaning, Prayer, Relaxation, One thing at a time, Vacation, Encouragement
IMPROVE.description: Techniques to make the present moment more bearable.
steps: Imagery: Imagine a safe place
Meaning: Find purpose in the pain
Prayer: Connect to something larger
Relaxation: Progressive muscle relaxation
One thing at a time: Focus on just this moment
Vacation: Take a brief mental break
Encouragement: Speak kindly to yourself
IMPROVE.bdsm_context: Useful for both Dominant and submissive during high-intensity scenes.

DEAR_MAN.name: DEAR MAN
DEAR_MAN.acronym_expansion: Describe, Express, Assert, Reinforce, Mindfully, Appear confident, Negotiate
DEAR_MAN.description: Assertive communication for getting needs met.
steps: Describe: State the facts
Express: Share your feelings
Assert: Ask for what you need
Reinforce: Explain the benefits
Mindfully: Stay focused on the goal
Appear confident: Use confident tone and posture
Negotiate: Be willing to give to get
DEAR_MAN.bdsm_context: Useful for scene negotiation and boundary setting before play.

GIVE.name: GIVE
GIVE.description: Maintaining the relationship while asserting needs.
steps: Gentle: Be soft and kind
Interested: Listen to the other person
Validate: Acknowledge their feelings
Easy manner: Use humor and lightness
GIVE.bdsm_context: Useful for maintaining the dynamic's health during difficult conversations.

FAST.name: FAST
FAST.acronym_expansion: Fair, Apologies (no excessive), Stick to values, Truthful
steps: Fair: Be fair to yourself and others
Apologies: No excessive apologies
Stick to values: Don't compromise your values
Truthful: Be honest
FAST.bdsm_context: Useful for maintaining boundaries and self-respect during scenes.

Wise_Mind.name: Wise Mind
Wise_Mind.description: The balance between reasonable mind and emotional mind.
steps: Notice when you are in reasonable mind
Notice when you are in emotional mind
Find the balance point — Wise Mind
Wise_Mind.bdsm_context: Useful for scene planning and aftercare decisions.

Self_Soothing.name: Self-Soothing through the Five Senses
Self_Soothing.description: Using the five senses to calm the nervous system.
Self_Soothing.bdsm_context: Core aftercare technique. Integrates with jewelry, toys, substances, and recovery actions.
